Maintain a steady speed, not a rushed one. Accuracy is more important than attempting everything. Remember, one correct answer gives you marks, but one silly mistake can cost you more.
Trust your preparation. You have worked hard, practiced consistently, and built your concepts. Now is the time to execute calmly. Don’t think about the result during the exam—just focus on giving your best in every single minute.
